information:
This competition is a special competition with **only 3x3x3 Fewest Moves** that takes place on a **Thursday evening**. If you are not familiar with Fewest Moves, please review [Article E of the WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#article-E-fewest-moves) before deciding to register. No other events besides Fewest Moves will be held.

Only one guest per competitor is permitted. Please consider coming without a guest if possible as spectator seating will be limited and Fewest Moves is not a particularly spectator-friendly event.
